what_it_shows: 214 staff accessed public generative AI sites in July 2026; a sample of 25 sessions found 3 pastes of patient details, referred to the Privacy Officer

title: PACS and RIS role, audit and vendor account report
source_system: PACS admin console (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: Radiologist and technologist roles mapped to directory groups; the PACS vendor administers the application and its server operating systems with its own support accounts; study access is logged in the application only; the AI triage module's model version is logged on each study

title: Help desk and interface queue reports, March to May 2026
source_system: IT service management system; interface engine monitoring
what_it_shows: Help desk ticket volumes and response times for hospital and affiliated practice users; interface queue depth and message volume reports

title: Organization chart and affiliated practice service responsibilities
source_system: Executive files; Director of Physician Services' files
what_it_shows: Organization chart with the vCISO reporting line and the IT and security team of 20; a responsibility matrix for the affiliated practice service owned by the Director of Physician Services

title: Control assessment: account management
source_system: IdP and EHR user exports; POL-02 draft; access review record (February 2026); samples from EV-060: 25 of 142 employee terminations, 25 of about 210 non-employee departures, 25 of 88 transfers, 25 of 296 new EHR accounts; IT Director interview
what_it_shows: Account types, managers, approvals, creation and monitoring as documented for all sampled items; 7 of 25 sampled non-employee departures still had active accounts more than 30 days after departure; non-employee accounts have no end date or sponsor attribute; 212 disabled non-employee accounts older than 1 year remain in the EHR; agencies and practices do not notify the hospital when users leave; transfers are not sent to EHR security, and 6 of 25 sampled transfers kept prior department roles; the last access review was February 2026, on an annual cycle; shared vendor passwords on clinical servers were not changed when IT and vendor staff left

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: Directory privileged group export; EHR super-user list; data warehouse role export
what_it_shows: 31 accounts hold standing domain administrator rights, including 12 vendor service accounts; 3 PACS vendor service accounts had domain administrator rights with non-expiring passwords; 6 analysts hold full-extract rights with no approval record

title: Control assessment: remote access
source_system: Remote access inventory; VPN account list; vendor access platform configuration; Information Security Manager interview
what_it_shows: Remote access types and usage restrictions are documented for employees and platform vendors; the 14 persistent vendor VPN accounts do not meet the documented connection requirements (no MFA, no recording); persistent VPN tunnels are authorized once at setup, not before each session; 3 of 6 legacy site-to-site VPNs have no written authorization

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: IdP and EHR user exports; generic account list; walkthrough of the ED and 3 units
what_it_shows: Processes acting for users are tied to unique identities in the EHR and directory; generic accounts remain on ED tracking boards and nursing displays, and shared local accounts on 2 laboratory analyzer workstations and the cath lab workstation

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: MFA sign-in test on 25 sampled privileged accounts (of 58 in EV-007) across the cloud, identity provider, EHR administration and directory
what_it_shows: Cloud, identity provider and EHR administrator sign-ins required MFA (17 of 17); on-campus directory administrator sign-ins did not (8 of 8 sampled)

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: IdP password policy; service account list; default-credential test on 20 networked devices and 6 clinical servers (vendor-approved, after hours, 2026-08-05)
what_it_shows: 4 of 20 sampled devices (laboratory analyzers and a fetal monitoring central station) accepted default credentials; the infusion pump server and the dispensing cabinet server share one vendor default local administrator password; vendor and service account passwords are not rotated and some date from installation; vendor passwords are kept in a spreadsheet on the IT file share; shared device workstation passwords are not changed when staff leave; identity provider password settings as configured

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: Termination checklists; access removal logs; badge system report; 25 of 142 employee terminations; HR Director interview
what_it_shows: System access disabled, exit interviews held and access to records handled for 25 of 25 sampled terminations; badges deactivated 2 to 9 days late in 3 of 25; return of badge, smartphone or laptop not documented in 4 of 25; shared device passwords known to the person were not changed

title: Control assessment: literacy training and awareness
source_system: Training completion report; phishing simulation results; 15 staff interviews
what_it_shows: Training, reminders and phishing simulations for employees and contracted clinicians run as recorded; affiliated practice users and agency nurses receive no initial security or privacy training from the hospital before access

title: Control assessment: event logging
source_system: SIEM source list; audit configuration of the LIS, cardiology system, fetal surveillance server and interface engine; MSSP service lead interview
what_it_shows: Event types are specified and coordinated with the MSSP for the EHR, identity, cloud and network; loggable events were not identified for the LIS, on-premises clinical servers, medical devices and OT; those events are not logged centrally, and local logs are kept 30 days or less; no written rationale for the selected event types; event types not reviewed since 2023

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: MSSP monthly reports; VIP access reports; EHR audit query on 10 randomly chosen non-VIP patients
what_it_shows: EHR audit review covers only VIP and employee records; the query on 10 random patients found 2 accesses with no apparent treatment relationship, referred to the Privacy Officer; findings are reported, and review levels were adjusted after a 2025 HC3 alert

title: Control assessment: configuration settings
source_system: Group policy export; benchmark configuration scan of 10 servers (of 52 in EV-012); network device configurations
what_it_shows: No documented settings for network devices, the virtualization cluster or vendor-managed clinical servers; 23% of benchmark settings on the 10 sampled servers were out of baseline; deviations are not documented or approved; configuration changes on managed servers are controlled through change tickets and monitored

title: Control assessment: system component inventory
source_system: CMDB; clinical engineering inventory; passive network capture on the clinical VLAN (2026-08-04)
what_it_shows: Passive capture found 64 devices on the clinical VLAN that were missing from the security inventory; the security inventory covers about 1,150 of 1,650 networked devices; OS, support end date and PHI storage are missing for most device records; MDS2 on file for 35% of models; device moves between units are not recorded in the security inventory; no duplicate accounting found

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: Unit downtime procedures (2022); emergency operations plan; BIA (P05); EHR vendor DR summary; interviews with the IT Director, Director of Emergency Management, CNO and 3 unit managers
what_it_shows: No IT contingency or disaster recovery plan sets recovery objectives, restoration priorities, metrics or named recovery contacts for the on-premises clinical servers; downtime procedures sustain essential functions for about 4 hours and have not been updated since 2022; problems from the 2025 hurricane exercise (phones, census) are open; essential functions, contingency roles and information sharing are covered by the BIA and the emergency operations plan's Hospital Incident Command System roles, which are access-controlled

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: Drill records; EHR vendor DR summary; restore test records
what_it_shows: No record of a contingency plan test for the hospital's own systems; downtime drills have not exceeded 4 hours; only the EHR vendor tests its disaster recovery

title: Control assessment: alternate telecommunications
source_system: Carrier contracts; telephony diagram; test call from 3 units with the campus network simulated down (2026-08-05)
what_it_shows: Alternate telecommunications exist only in the ED and the house supervisor office; the 3 units tested had no working phone path with the campus network simulated down

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup job reports (31 of 31 July 2026 days); backup account retention settings; restore of one file share folder from the backup account
what_it_shows: 31 of 31 July 2026 backup days completed; cloud copies encrypted and write-once in a separate account; 1 file share folder restored from the backup account; the fetal surveillance server and cardiology system are backed up only by their vendors to local disks; the backup appliance is joined to the hospital directory

title: Control assessment: recovery and reconstitution
source_system: Recovery documentation; IT Director interview
what_it_shows: No recovery of a clinical server within its RTO has been demonstrated; no reconstitution procedure exists

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: Incident log (10 of the 41 incidents in EV-036 sampled); 2025 tabletop report; MSSP runbooks; P08 runbook drafts
what_it_shows: 8 of 10 sampled incidents followed preparation, detection, containment, eradication and recovery steps; incident handling is not yet integrated with the emergency operations plan and downtime procedures; lessons from 2 incidents in 2025 (phishing and a vendor outage) were not carried into procedures; no defined steps for medical devices and OT

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: POL-03; 15 staff interviews; incident reports
what_it_shows: 15 of 15 randomly selected staff described how to report a suspected incident; reports reach the incident register

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: Incident response plan and P08 runbook drafts (approved later, on 2026-09-17); distribution records
what_it_shows: The draft plan and runbooks set structure, roles, reportable incidents, resources, information sharing and responsibility and are access-controlled; they have no metrics; distribution to clinical leaders, house supervisors, the MSSP and key vendors, and a process to communicate plan changes, were not in place

title: Control assessment: nonlocal maintenance
source_system: Vendor access platform logs; VPN account list and logs; 10 remote maintenance sessions sampled
what_it_shows: Platform sessions are allowed by policy, documented in the SSP and ended after maintenance; sessions over the 14 persistent VPN accounts are not approved individually, monitored or recorded and use no MFA; no maintenance record for 4 of 10 sampled VPN sessions; persistent site-to-site tunnels stay up between sessions

title: Control assessment: media sanitization
source_system: Destruction certificates for IT media; 6 device returns to vendors in 2026 (EV-051)
what_it_shows: IT media sanitization and destruction certificates on file; 4 of 6 device returns (2 ultrasound units, 1 leased copier, 1 CT workstation drive) left without a sanitization certificate

title: Control assessment: physical access
source_system: Badge system reports; walkthrough of the data center, pharmacy, nursery and 12 of 41 network closets; visitor log
what_it_shows: Badge enforcement, escorting and visitor control in place at the data center, pharmacy and nursery; no access logs for the 9 keyed network closets; closet keys kept in an unlocked drawer in the IT office; keys not changed since 2019 despite staff departures

title: Control assessment: risk assessment
source_system: P01 risk register and report; 2025 risk analysis (EV-032); vCISO interview
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk analysis, completed 2026-07-17 under SP 800-30, identifies threats and vulnerabilities, rates likelihood and impact, and is documented, reviewed and disseminated; the June 2025 analysis was the prior annual analysis

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring
source_system: Scan reports Q1-Q2 2026 (EV-018); 48 Critical findings traced to closure
what_it_shows: Scanning tools, analysis and sharing operate as recorded; 48 Critical findings took 41 days on average to close, and 9 of 48 took more than 60 days; medical devices, OT and vendor-managed servers are not scanned, actively or passively

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch compliance reports; change tickets; device firmware records
what_it_shows: Flaw identification, reporting, testing and change integration operate; 12% of workstations and 3 servers missed the 30-day patch window in July 2026; device firmware updates are applied only when vendors schedule visits; 210 devices cannot be updated

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: BAA register (EV-041); 20 vendors sampled from accounts payable; 15 Tier 1 vendor files
what_it_shows: 4 of 20 sampled vendors handled PHI without a BAA or security review (42 overall); oversight roles and responsibilities are documented; Tier 1 vendors are reviewed only at onboarding

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments and reviews
source_system: Tier 1 vendor files
what_it_shows: No Tier 1 vendor has been reassessed since onboarding; the PACS vendor has no SOC 2 report

title: Control assessment: unsupported system components
source_system: Unsupported device list; Director of Biomedical Engineering interview
what_it_shows: 210 unsupported devices have no replacement dates; compensating controls exist only for imaging; extended vendor support is in place for the imaging modalities

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Firewall rule exports; VLAN map; reachability test from a nursing workstation (2026-08-05)
what_it_shows: External interfaces are monitored and controlled through managed boundary devices; from a nursing workstation, testers reached patient monitors, analyzers, dispensing cabinets, the cath lab system and the building automation controller; traffic inside the clinical VLAN and OT network is not monitored

title: Control assessment: protection of information at rest
source_system: Encryption reports for endpoints, servers, cloud storage and backups
what_it_shows: ePHI at rest on endpoints, servers, cloud storage and backups is encrypted

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection
source_system: EDR coverage report; EICAR test files on 5 endpoints
what_it_shows: EDR detected and quarantined every test file within 4 minutes and alerted the MSSP

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: SIEM use cases; simulated impossible-travel sign-in; MSSP escalation records
what_it_shows: The MSSP escalated the simulated sign-in within 22 minutes; monitoring of identity, endpoints and the perimeter operates; no internal monitoring sensors and no monitoring for unauthorized local connections on the clinical VLAN, device VLANs or OT network

title: Control assessment: software, firmware and information integrity
source_system: Pump server and dispensing cabinet server configuration; interface engine change log; Pharmacy Director interview
what_it_shows: EHR vendor integrity controls and firmware integrity checks on pumps are in place; no integrity verification of software on the pump and cabinet servers; no detection of, or defined action for, unauthorized changes to the drug library or interface mappings
